resources.string: Save a report to this idea on your device. It includes the reported generated text, category, optional note and report time. It does not add user-written answers, full transcript, keys or connection settings. Unedited AI suggestions and drafts are generated text; generated text itself may contain private details. Reports are included in this idea’s markdown export and session backups. Saving does not send anything to the developer or a model provider.
Saved to this idea and its export. Nothing was automatically sent to the developer.
Saving locally. This may wait for work already running on this idea.
The report was not saved. Your category and note are still here; try again. %1$s
The idea changed or was deleted before this operation could complete. Nothing new was saved. %1$s

If this is still the current unanswered question, replace it with a different built-in checklist question. No answer or coverage change is recorded. Your unsent draft stays for you to edit. Voice stays paused.
A different checklist question is ready. No answer was recorded and coverage is unchanged.
Different question from the built-in checklist, not AI-generated
The question was not replaced. Your saved report and unsent draft are unchanged. %1$s
Optional: open your email app to %1$s with only this report’s generated text, category and note. Review and send it there. Opening the composer is not proof of delivery.
Optional developer email is unavailable until the project confirms a privacy contact. Your local report and export still work.
No email composer could be opened. Your report is still saved locally; you can export it or try again.
